summary: End-to-end tested Professional Certified Badges & Testing System — backend (22/22 pytest passing) and frontend flows (worker cert test/fail flow, admin queue + Badges CRUD + real AI quiz generation ~30s, gig gating chip/pill/cert-required-card).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> in FeedFilters.jsx (SORT_OPTIONS map with x-source overlay span). Cosmetic dev-mode warning only, but violates HTML spec.

critical_code_review_comments: badges.py duplicates the already-taken check across GET/POST /worker/badges/{id}/test — fine, DRY-acceptable.
Consider dependency-injecting `emergentintegrations.llm.chat` at module scope instead of importing inside the endpoint to avoid per-request import cost.
worker_upload_doc's returned document list is computed client-side (`app.get('documents') + [doc]`) instead of re-reading persisted state — small stale-data risk if concurrent uploads.
admin_generate_quiz should log the failing raw AI response for observability (currently only logs exception message).
seed_badges uses upsert with $setOnInsert only — if a seed badge is later edited (e.g., pass_pct) the seed will not update on restart. Acceptable given the current desire to allow admin edits.
seed_data_creation: Reset demo worker's badge_applications and certified_badges to empty state at end of run. Deleted 580 stale TEST_-prefixed gigs (accumulated across prior iterations).

AI quiz generation runs real Claude — ~10-30s. Gig create requires category ∈ {cleaning, labor, driver}; use 'labor' or 'cleaning' with required_badge_id.
